_source: Updated 2026-09-04 from the Notion OFFER TRACKING parser run: 50 live partners; ceiling total 36336 published as $36,000+. total_value_exact is required - without it the widget stat tile silently falls back to the rounded figure. Uncapped-earn rows (ShopYourLikes, Insense, Driff, TopFan) count as live partners but their figures never enter the total. ShopYourLikes' '~$1,000-$1,500/yr' is an illustrative example Avi invented and must never be published. CreatorIQ is live with a one-time event ticket and contributes $0. Largest single discount remains $7,200 (CreatorCare).
